question: MG Music Awards is presented annually by which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The MG Music Awards is an annual music awards show presented by the** Musicians Guild Nagaland**.
 
• The first edition was held virtually in **2021**, while the second edition took place offline in **2022 at the RCEMPA Hall in Jotsoma, Nagaland**.
 
• The awards aim to recognize and celebrate musical talent from the northeastern states of India.
 
• The 2022 edition featured 12 categories, including Best Rock Artist, **Best Indie Artist, Best Rap/Hiphop Artist, Best Gospel Artist, Best Folk Fusion Artist,** Best Electronic Artist, Best Pop Solo Artist, Best Pop Duo/Group, Best Sound Engineer, Most Promising Artist,and Song of the Year.
 
• The awards ceremony also included performances by various artists from the region.
 
• The MG Music Awards have become a significant platform for showcasing and promoting the diverse musical talent of the northeastern states.
